quest.title: The Cannon Has Ears
quest.description: The Gardes are facing an emergency in the south of Fontaine. It appears they need assistance...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Hey-ho! Here comes the relief force...

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you two doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Have we met before?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Nothing wrong at all! It's good to see such famously strong heroes here to help!

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Back in the unit — and after I returned to the village, too — everyone said you two could take care of anything.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: On the other hand, those two over there are reliable enough, but there's something a little... awkward between them.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Human emotions are complicated... I think maybe they could do with a little push.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: Awkward?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Forget it. There are more important things to focus on.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Anyway, I have faith in you. The cannon's easy enough to operate. I'm sure you'll have those monsters cleared up in short order.

choices.text: I feel like we've met before...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: So you do remember me! I applied for a position at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks she maybe remembers that...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: I'm well aware of your deeds, and I know I can trust you with anything.

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: We've been at this for half a day now, and the monsters aren't showing any signs of thinning out...

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Maybe I should call for reinforcements?

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: There's no need to panic. Trust in the cannon and our plainclothes colleague!

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: Besides, there's an adventurer with a nose for danger and a certain officer who are sure to turn up should we find ourselves in a crisis...

choices.text: What's all this about a crisis?

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: #Wow, here they are... Proto-Boss and {M#his}{F#her} little assistant really have shown up!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Hello, you two. Please allow me to explain the situation...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Why don't you take a breather? I can brief these two.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Hey! Want to have a go on the cannon? Opportunities like this don't roll around often, at least, not since the fleet was destroyed. It'll be a blast from centuries past!

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Blowing monsters to smithereens with these specially made projectiles is the perfect way to unwind — and the Gardes will even reward you for it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Blasting monsters with a massive cannon... That's right up our alley!

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: I understand your excitement, Proto-Boss, but we're still on a knife's edge here. Let me fill you in on what's happening.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Recently, a group of workers unexpectedly unearthed some ruins nearby, disturbing the monsters slumbering within...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: We Gardes have set up a containment zone to prevent their escape.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Well, I say "containment zone"... At the moment, it's just the two of us and a Melusine agent who happened to be here on holiday... Oh, and our customized cannon, of course!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eek! That sounds dangerous! Paimon hopes that Melusine agent isn't in any danger...

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Don't worry about her. The cannon at the entrance to the ruins is operated remotely — she can keep most of the monsters in check without getting anywhere near them.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: She's very reliable, but this operation's dragging on now, and she must be exhausted.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Will you help us out, Proto-Boss? If the situation doesn't improve soon, I'll have to call for reinforcements.

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: #What are you talking about, Chenee? You know how capable our Proto-Boss is — with {M#him}{F#her} in control, my cannon will wipe out those monsters in no time flat!

choices.text: Say no more. I'd love to give this cannon a blast...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not our style to walk away from danger!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Fantastic! We're very grateful for your help.

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: After our last experiment, I made some adjustments to my invention — I hope you'll find it easy to operate.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: *sigh* Now, if only we could get it to aim and fire automatically... What do you think?

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: That's a great idea! Next time, I can try fitting it with a Gardemek's target identification module! That way, it should be able to operate autonomously.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: How clever — you really are a genius!

choices.text: I'm willing to help no matter the situation!
Is there a particular reason for blowing these monsters up?
We got here in time, I hope?
